svg.title: Vanguard Fusion Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 93-94, PDF 94-95. Combined exterior follows larger Deck 1 with narrow rounded bow, broad bulbous aft aerofoils and twin rear drives; upper Deck 2 is contained. Source illustration corroborates pear-shaped hull. Common exterior with Vanguard-M is explicitly supported by its same-hull text and both plans. Barbettes and detached keys excluded.
